diff --git a/src/click/eof_control_key.py b/src/click/eof_control_key.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..01a29f9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/eof_control_key.py
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from ._compat import WIN
+
+
+def eof_control_key(ch: str) -> None:
+    """Like ``_translate_ch_to_exc``, but treats Ctrl+C as end of input
+    by raising :exc:`EOFError` instead of :exc:`KeyboardInterrupt`.
+    """
+    if ch == "\x03":
+        raise EOFError()
+
+    if ch == "\x04" and not WIN:  # Unix-like, Ctrl+D
+        raise EOFError()
+
+    if ch == "\x1a" and WIN:  # Windows, Ctrl+Z
+        raise EOFError()
+
+    return None
diff --git a/tests/test_eof_control_key.py b/tests/test_eof_control_key.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d05f10d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_eof_control_key.py
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click.eof_control_key
+from click.eof_control_key import eof_control_key
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("win", [True, False])
+def test_ctrl_c_raises_eof(monkeypatch, win):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.eof_control_key, "WIN", win)
+
+    with pytest.raises(EOFError):
+        eof_control_key("\x03")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("win", "ch", "raises"),
+    [
+        (False, "\x04", True),
+        (True, "\x04", False),
+        (True, "\x1a", True),
+        (False, "\x1a", False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_platform_eof_keys(monkeypatch, win, ch, raises):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.eof_control_key, "WIN", win)
+
+    if raises:
+        with pytest.raises(EOFError):
+            eof_control_key(ch)
+    else:
+        assert eof_control_key(ch) is None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("ch", ["", "a", "\x00", "\r", "\x03\x03", "\x1b"])
+def test_other_input_returns_none(ch):
+    assert eof_control_key(ch) is None
